_comment: Real, currently-in-progress production batches -- distinct from docs/whistlebird-production-sheet-source.json, which is the founder's historical spreadsheet of batches that have already finished every step. An entry here started recently and has NOT finished every step yet: it draws its tracked ingredients from whatever real stock the live tenant currently holds (FIFO, oldest purchase_date first), not from a historical purchase ledger, since these ARE that stock. Only the maceration step is supported today; extending to distilling/aging/bottling is a deliberate follow-up. See scripts/whistlebird_recent_batches.py.

batches.note: Founder-confirmed (2026-09-22): maceration put on tonight for a new Solstice batch. VAT number is chosen later, at Aging.
